# Altitude Of

Source: [wiki article 4561](../archive/4561.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Altitude Of](../../api/values/altitude-of.md).

<a id="wiki-4561-n1"></a>

- Altitude measures height above a surface in meters and returns zero while on a surface; it is not raw world Y.
